documentation.content: Runbook row: API request failures (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. This condition thresholds an absolute 5xx count as a proxy for the runbook's proposed >5%-of->=20-total-requests ratio rule; a true ratio needs a query-language condition, which is outside the REST field-name allowlist this slice uses. Initial, review after 7 days once real traffic volume is known.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="{{PROJECT}}" AND resource.labels.service_name="chirp-api" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"
